body_json.answer:
**Assessment:** rejected.

The new post's general claim that mainstream media coverage is "incomplete or misleading" closely echoes [T4-009470](#T4-009470), which asserts that mainstream media "simply prints the lies outright" rather than merely spinning stories, and shares a critical framing with [T4-008246](#T4-008246), which derides outlets as "Fake News" reporting on fake news. [T4-006638](#T4-006638) touches the same target but only poses the question of whether the media is "an enemy of the American people," making it a prompt for opinion rather than an assertion like the new post. By contrast, [T4-004417](#T4-004417) pushes back on a related complaint, arguing that media "can multi task and cover many topics" beyond politics, which cuts against the incompleteness framing. [T4-008799](#T4-008799) merely names "Mainstream media" with a link and offers no evaluable claim, so any similarity there is weak.
